name: google-news
label: Google News
title: Google News for AI Agents — FlashData
summary: Find news articles, publishers and dates for AI research and news-monitoring workflows. Export structured titles, links and snippets.
use: Discover recent industry coverage, compare publisher sources, and feed a research agent a shortlist of news URLs.
limits: Returns news search metadata and available snippets, not article full text. Dates may be relative or absent. The agent must open and evaluate sources before citing claims.

name: google-images
label: Google Images
title: Google Images for AI Agents — FlashData
summary: Find image references and source pages for AI research assistants. Export image URLs, thumbnails, available dimensions and ranked source links.
use: Help an agent discover visual references, trace an image to its source page, and collect candidates for later review.
limits: Returns image references, not image files or reuse licenses. Original image URLs can expire or require access. Review source rights before using an image.

name: google-shopping
label: Google Shopping
title: Google Shopping for AI Agents — FlashData
summary: Discover product offers for AI shopping and market-research assistants. Export product titles, merchants, available prices, ratings and URLs.
use: Collect a product-offer snapshot for an agent to compare merchants, investigate competitors, or build a shopping brief.
limits: Prices are provider-reported snapshots, may include currency text, and can change. Does not guarantee stock, final checkout price, exhaustive merchant coverage or product equivalence.

name: google-videos
label: Google Videos
title: Google Video Search for AI Agents — FlashData
summary: Discover videos across websites for AI research agents. Export Google Video results with titles, links and available duration, channel and date metadata.
use: Find video explanations across multiple websites and supply candidate sources to a research or educational assistant.
limits: This is Google Video search, not YouTube's internal search. Returns links and metadata, not downloaded media, transcripts, or verified content claims.

name: google-places
label: Google Places
title: Google Places for AI Agents — FlashData
summary: Find local businesses and places for AI research assistants. Export available addresses, coordinates, ratings, phone numbers and business websites.
use: Build local-business shortlists, investigate locations, or provide candidate places for a travel or market-research agent.
limits: Results are search snapshots. Phone, website, coordinates, price level and ratings may be absent. Does not guarantee complete business coverage or current opening hours.

name: youtube-search
label: YouTube Search
title: YouTube Search for AI Agents — FlashData
summary: Find YouTube videos for AI research and content-discovery agents. Export titles, video IDs and available channel, duration and view metadata; request up to 20 results.
use: Discover videos by topic, apply supported search filters, and pass video IDs to a metadata or transcript tool.
limits: Standard search requests 1–20 results (default 20); actual results may be fewer. Does not download videos or retrieve transcripts. Search filters affect discovery, not licensing or suitability guarantees.

name: youtube-search-extended
label: YouTube Extended Search
title: YouTube Extended Search for AI Agents — FlashData
summary: Collect larger YouTube discovery sets for AI research agents. Request up to 700 video results with available channel and video metadata; uses the extended-search rate.
use: Build a larger candidate-video collection for market research, topic exploration, or a downstream agent's selection workflow.
limits: Requests 1–700 results (default 20), at a separate higher rate than standard search. The upper limit is not a delivery guarantee. No automatic pagination, recurring collection, or transcript retrieval.

name: youtube-metadata
label: YouTube Metadata
title: YouTube Metadata for AI Agents — FlashData
summary: Read YouTube video metadata for AI research agents. Get available titles, channels, statistics, chapters and formats as structured JSON from a video ID.
use: Inspect a candidate video before retrieving its transcript, navigating chapters, or choosing a media-processing step.
limits: Fields depend on video availability. Formats and chapters are optional; metadata does not grant download, reuse, or training rights. The Actor does not download the video.

name: youtube-transcript
label: YouTube Transcript
title: YouTube Transcripts for AI Agents — FlashData
summary: Get existing YouTube automatic captions for AI research and summarization workflows. Export timestamped segments and retain full transcript text in JSON.
use: Supply time-aligned source text to a research or summarization agent, which can inspect the text and associate claims with video timestamps.
limits: Reads existing captions only. Defaults to automatic captions (auto=true) in English. No speech recognition, translation, or automatic fallback to uploader captions. Availability is not guaranteed; automatic captions can contain errors.

name: youtube-captions
label: YouTube Uploader Captions
title: YouTube Uploader Captions for AI Agents — FlashData
summary: Read existing uploader-provided YouTube captions for AI agents. Export timestamped segments in a selected language and retain full caption text as JSON.
use: Retrieve an available uploader caption track for an agent's quotation, video research, or multilingual-source review workflow.
limits: Defaults to uploader-provided captions (auto=false) in English. Does not generate captions, translate, or fall back to automatic captions. A missing track is a valid availability limitation, not a reason to repeat the request automatically.

name: youtube-trainability
label: YouTube License Metadata
title: YouTube License Metadata for AI Agents — FlashData
summary: Inspect a YouTube video's Creative Commons license label for AI research workflows. Returns the license classification in JSON; it does not grant training or reuse permission.
use: Let an agent record the available license-label classification as one piece of metadata during a source review.
limits: The API source is named youtube_trainability, but it checks license metadata, not the creator's third-party AI-training setting. permitted=["all"] means the Creative Commons label was detected; ["none"] includes absent license metadata. Neither result grants permission or replaces a rights assessment.

name: youtube-channel
label: YouTube Channel
title: YouTube Channels for AI Agents — FlashData
summary: Inspect YouTube channels and recent videos for AI research agents. Use a channel handle to retrieve profile data and a recent-video sample of up to 100 items.
use: Build a channel profile, inspect recent publishing topics, and pass selected video IDs into metadata or caption workflows.
limits: Use a handle, with or without @; do not use a full URL or channel ID. video_limit is 1–100 (default 20); this is a recent-video sample, not the complete channel history. Profile counts may be absent and are not converted to zero.

name: youtube-suggestions
label: YouTube Autocomplete
title: YouTube Autocomplete for AI Agents — FlashData
summary: Discover YouTube autocomplete phrases for AI topic-research agents. Submit a query prefix with language and region and export one suggestion per dataset row.
use: Explore query wording and candidate subtopics before an agent chooses which YouTube searches to perform.
limits: Suggestions are phrases, not video results, search-volume estimates, or popularity rankings. Empty suggestions are valid. Each language/region request is separate; the Actor does not expand queries automatically.

name: youtube-download
label: YouTube to Cloud Storage
title: YouTube to Cloud Storage for AI Agents — FlashData
summary: Deliver YouTube video or audio to your cloud storage for AI workflows. Submit one download job, read progress and export its delivery manifest. Uses your FlashData Key and Credits; Apify usage is separate.
use: Deliver media into a storage location you control for an authorized downstream processing workflow. The agent can inspect the job status and delivery manifest.
limits: Async only. Requires your own supported storage and credentials; does not provide a shared public download bucket. Private files remain subject to your storage access controls. You are responsible for permission to obtain and use the media. No speech recognition or translation is included.
